published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Keeps Judgement of the Crusader on the boss for the raid.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -4.5s, Seal of Command at -3s, Seal of the Crusader at -1.5s. Replacing Seal of Command leaves its Echo for the first swing
Judgement of the Crusader at the pull, for the duty. It adds 161 Holy damage taken for 40s. The paladin's melee hits refresh it, so one cast lasts the fight. Judge it again only if it drops
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Consecration
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Command up, switch to Seal of Righteousness in the last 1.5s before a swing, then back to Command before the next. One switch per swing, at any mana. Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Dragonfire Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent. It costs nothing here, because it replaced Purifying Power, which does nothing on this boss.
Uses Libram of Fervor (+33 to Judgement of the Crusader). At 180s it beats Libram of Law by 5.9 DPS on twist duty and 7.7 on Shock duty.
Purifying Power does nothing on the generic boss.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization boosts Holy seal damage, as in the Era sim. The client says Physical only. Without it, DPS is 11 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing. The Goblin Land Mine and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb cost 6.1 DPS at 180s, and the EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade 6.9.
notes: Request: paladin__level_60_sub_holy with raid debuff judgementOfTheCrusader removed and the level60_crusader_duty rotation. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human (follows its base build, paladin__level_60_sub_holy). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
